values.pixelSize: profile footprint, about 170 km along track
values.cleaningNote: MRO Mars Climate Sounder DDR profile records, 116 days sampled every 6 days from 2010-07-01 to 2012-05-21 (one Mars year, Ls 2-360); 684 files read. Kept records with geometry quality 0-1, radiance quality 0, standard forward viewing, surface-temperature error < 5 K, missing code -9999 removed. Pooled every profile whose surface footprint is within 250 km of the site: 117 afternoon (local time 6-18 h, about 3 pm), 143 night (about 3 am). MCS only observes near 3 am and 3 pm local time. Mean = average of the 3 pm mean and the 3 am mean.

MOLA median topography in metres relative to the areoid, 16-bit big-endian integers; where no laser shot fell in a bin the product supplies an interpolated value; nearest pixel.

MOLA median topography in metres relative to the areoid, 16-bit big-endian integers; where no laser shot fell in a bin the product supplies an interpolated value; nearest pixel. Relief = highest minus lowest of 9 samples (centre and 8 neighbours at +/-15 km), the same definition as the Earth sites.

P = 0.61 kPa x exp(-h / 11.1 km), with h the MOLA elevation above the areoid. 0.61 kPa is the mean areoid pressure and 11.1 km the scale height from the NASA Mars fact sheet. A model, not a measurement: it ignores the seasonal swing of about +/-15%.

values.cleaningNote: Mars Climate Database v6.2 global climate model, climatology average-solar scenario. Queried horizontal wind speed at target coordinates (18.4° latitude, 77.60000000000002° east longitude) and 10 m above local surface, with high-resolution topography off. Mean of 576 model values on the 15° solar-longitude by 1-hour local-time grid (duplicate 360°/24-hour endpoints excluded). Model climatology, not a rover measurement or forecast.

datasets.name: LRO LOLA global and polar DEMs
datasets.role: Elevation and local relief at every Moon site
steps: Read the .lbl label: size, 32-bit float format, unit km, reference radius 1737.4 km
Check the file size equals lines x samples x 4 bytes
Locate the site and its 8 neighbours at 15 km on the map (polar stereographic below 60 S, cylindrical elsewhere)
Read those pixels by HTTP byte range; subtract the reference radius; relief = highest minus lowest

datasets.name: LRO Diviner Level 3 bolometric temperature maps
datasets.role: Mean, coldest and warmest surface temperature at every Moon site
steps: Read all 2011 day and night maps (29 per product) and check each label and file size
Mask the missing-data code (-32768); reject values outside 20-450 K; DN x 0.02 = kelvin
Pool every pixel within 15 km of the site, separately for daytime and nighttime maps
Mean = average of day mean and night mean; coldest = coldest 10% of night pixels; warmest = warmest 10% of day pixels

datasets.name: MGS MOLA MEGDR topography (128 pixel/degree)
datasets.role: Elevation and local relief at every Mars site; input for derived pressure
steps: Pick the tile covering each point; read the label and check the file size
Read the centre and 8 neighbours at 15 km by HTTP byte range (16-bit big-endian metres above the areoid)
Relief = highest minus lowest, the same definition as Earth

datasets.name: MRO Mars Climate Sounder DDR profiles
datasets.role: Mean, coldest and warmest surface temperature at every Mars site
steps: Download 116 days spread over one Mars year (every 6 days), 6 files per day
Keep records with good geometry and radiance quality flags, standard viewing and a surface-temperature error below 5 K; drop -9999 codes
Pool every profile within 250 km of the site, split into 3 pm and 3 am (MCS sees only those two local times)
Mean = average of 3 pm and 3 am means; coldest = coldest 10% of 3 am profiles; warmest = warmest 10% of 3 pm profiles

datasets.name: Mars surface pressure model
datasets.role: Surface pressure at every Mars site
steps: P = 0.61 kPa x exp(-h / 11.1 km), h = MOLA elevation
A model, not a measurement

datasets.name: Mars Climate Database v6.2 GCM climatology (average solar scenario)
datasets.role: Modeled near-surface wind at every Mars site
steps: Query horizontal wind speed at each site, 10 m above the local surface
Use the average-solar climatology scenario and the full 15° solar-longitude by 1-hour local-time grid
Exclude duplicate 360° solar-longitude and 24-hour local-time endpoints; average the remaining 576 model values
MCD is a global climate-model climatology, not a rover measurement or forecast
